name: duplicate-top-level-dsl-block
description: A repeated destination top-level Ruby DSL block with identical content must be recognized as already represented by the template match.

merge.template:
source "https://gem.coop"

direct_sibling_gems = %w[
  ast-merge
  json-merge
]

if direct_sibling_gems.any?
  eval_nomono_gems(gems: direct_sibling_gems)
end

eval_gemfile "gemfiles/modular/debug.gemfile"
